brand.tone: friendly kawaii CRT terminal with disciplined neon pixel art
brand.audience_boundary: marketing operators and developers who need a readable intelligence console, not a game-world illustration
brand.identity_statement: A local-first marketing intelligence terminal expressed through crisp, low-resolution pixel sprites, live terminal typography, and restrained pink/cyan structure.

references.scope: authoritative palette, grids, roles, silhouettes, placement, and delivery constraints
generation prompts, conform command, and verification workflow
review-only mood, layout, and character placement; not a palette or geometry authority

shape_layout: square corners and shared framed-nav geometry
transparent gaps are intentional in mask glyphs
centred subjects with protected negative space
hierarchy: pink marks active or primary UI states
cyan marks secondary or idle UI states
simple facial features remain legible at native size
mutable UI text stays outside raster art
palette_rules: use the exact terminal packet palette
use pink/cyan/green/gold/red ramps only as specified
Twitter blue #3fa8f0 and Reddit orange #ff7a3c are platform-only exceptions
lighting_depth: no gradients, blur, glow, bloom, bevel, or drop shadow
texture_restraint: CRT atmosphere comes from live CSS, not baked raster effects

prohibited: mixed-size grid cells or non-integer scaling
unapproved characters, props, or trade dress
using the 3D installer icon as a terminal-art reference

nav_mask.output_contract: 16x16 native grid, 64x64 export, pure white silhouette, transparent binary alpha, scale 4
allowed_variation: subject silhouette and transparent interior gaps only
framed glyphs reuse the shared 1px rounded-square frame
prohibited: different frame geometry between framed glyphs

full_colour_sprite.purpose: KPI, panel, feed, social, and decorative marks
full_colour_sprite.output_contract: packet native grid, 4x nearest-neighbour export, palette-snapped binary-alpha PNG
allowed_variation: bounded silhouette details needed for readability
prohibited: gradients, blur, glow, or soft shadow
unapproved hues except sanctioned platform colours

mascot.purpose: cat, monitor, and blob personality sprites
mascot.output_contract: packet mascot grid, 4x export, transparent binary-alpha PNG, readable at runtime crop
allowed_variation: palette-step shading within the locked ramps
small pose or expression refinement that preserves the named anchor
prohibited: missing raised paw, monitor smile, or blob scallops
speech bubbles, labels, or extra props

brand_favicon.purpose: pixel wordmark and browser/app identity assets
brand_favicon.text_strategy: live_engine_text for UI wordmark; licensed type rasterization for the pixel lockup
brand_favicon.output_contract: wordmark rasterized at integer scale; favicons derived from conformed cat-mark on opaque #12101f

production_rules.text_strategy: Keep labels and UI copy live in the DOM; do not bake text into generated sprites.
production_rules.logo_strategy: Use the cat mark as a conformed sprite and draw the wordmark with licensed Departure Mono at integer scale.
production_rules.font_strategy: Vend Departure Mono v1.500 by Helena Zhang under SIL OFL 1.1 with local and vendored WOFF2/WOFF fallbacks.
production_rules.transparency: Clean simple chroma-key source images with the imagegen helper, then require binary alpha after pixelize-asset; favicons are opaque #12101f.
production_rules.provenance_record: Record source path, reference roles, prompt/workflow, conform command, dimensions, hashes, review result, and promotion state in docs/design/asset-ledger.md.

change_control.owner: Marketingovo product owner with Codex implementation review
change_control.update_trigger: Any change to palette, grid, silhouette anchor, type/logo strategy, or asset-family contract
change_control.versioning: Amend ASSET_ART_BIBLE.md and this lock together with a version bump and migration note before regenerating affected assets.

open_decisions: Owner approval is required before promoting the draft lock to approved or locked production authority.
Confirm whether a future font subset should retain the full box-drawing set or use only the packet's explicit symbol list.
